div.head: NOTES BY THE WAY AT EAELESTOWN.
div.p: NOTES BY THE WAY AT EAELESTOWN.
(BY AN OrcAtoloNAL CoItRESI NONNY).

The influenza demon reigns supreme in Harlem- town just now, and the doctors have just about as much as they can to to cope with it. The number of canes is something extraordinary, and, what in worse, there in every indication that they will in- crease. Not only are adult. people affected, hut the school children appear to suffer from • mild form. The symptoms are headache, Insnitudodeverishnons, and vomiting, but whether all thin is due to influ- enza or not lam not prepared to say. The disorder in infectious, and the cases are so numerous, that I flunk the school authorities should exercise the . greatest vigilance in order to prevent, it possible, a spread of the complaint._ The Social Cycling well to rem.° its headquarters to the Wellington Inn. I see they have had a board put up informing all and sundry as to the location of their headquarter*. Taste appears to me to he a little more energy thrown in- ! to the work this year, and I hope it way hear goal fruit. The smoker this week was very successful, and there was nome good ninging. It only needs an attractive fixture card and a few good social gatherings much as the one referred to, to make the club a PIICCOSS.
